output.title: Arrival rate
output.formula: λ = arrivals ÷ measurement window

output.title: Capacity from slots
output.formula: capacity = slots × 1000 ÷ mean holding time
output.note: Holding time is how long a request keeps its slot (worker, connection or executor), including downstream calls when the slot blocks on them.

output.title: Utilization
output.formula: ρ = λ × mean holding time ÷ (1000 × slots)
output.note: Measured by the simulation: 77.2% of slot-time busy.

output.title: Little's law
output.formula: requests inside = λ × mean time inside
output.note: Measured: 12.9 requests inside on average. Little's law holds for any stable system, so the two should agree closely.

output.title: Queueing model (M/M/c)
output.formula: Wq = C(c, a) ÷ (c·μ − λ),  a = λ ÷ μ,  μ = 1000 ÷ mean holding time
output.note: Simulated mean wait: 0.48 ms. M/M/c assumes random arrivals and exponential holding times; bursts, heavier tails and downstream waits push the real wait above it.
